title: QUAG SMP - Survival Server
description: A Vanilla Minecraft SMP made by the QUAG podcast.
body:
#  🌍 Welcome to QUAG SMP 🌍! 
### Based in Europe, this server is dedicated to providing the best vanilla experience. 

We've built our server alongside the QUAG SMP modpack to remove  lag, upgrade the visuals, and make everyday gameplay more enjoyable, while keeping the vanilla Minecraft survival feel intact.


## **How to join**

1. [Join the patreon ](https://www.patreon.com/cw/QUAGFRIDAYS)
2. Link your discord with your patreon account
3. Join the Discord server
4. Link account
5. Join!

### **📋 Server Information** 
Server IP: Join the Patreon

Version: Java Edition 1.21.11

Region: Europe 🇪🇺
